card.name: Commas in lists of medical conditions
card.fires_on: Commas (and the ".," after "e.g") that separate items in a list of diseases, conditions or causes in medical text. The next item is another condition.

modes.label: Comma between conditions
modes.description: A comma after one condition in a series of causes, patient groups or diagnoses.
modes.example: Pregnancy, infectious hepatitis<<,>> estrogens, estrogen-containing oral contrace
